components.name: 主按钮
components.css: .ds-button{cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line,#cbd9d0); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; background: var(--surface,#fcfefd); color: var(--ink,#203b32); transition: background .16s ease-out;}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background: var(--tint,#dcece3);}.ds-button:disabled{opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed;}.ds-button{min-height:42px;font-family:'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#21684b);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button.ds-primary{background: var(--accent,#21684b); color: var(--surface,#fcfefd); border-color: var(--accent,#21684b); font-weight: 600;}.ds-button.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){filter: brightness(.92); background: var(--accent,#21684b);}

components.name: 普通按钮
components.css: .ds-button{cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line,#cbd9d0); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; background: var(--surface,#fcfefd); color: var(--ink,#203b32); transition: background .16s ease-out;}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background: var(--tint,#dcece3);}.ds-button:disabled{opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed;}.ds-button{min-height:42px;font-family:'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#21684b);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: 文字按钮
components.css: .ds-button{cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line,#cbd9d0); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; background: var(--surface,#fcfefd); color: var(--ink,#203b32); transition: background .16s ease-out;}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background: var(--tint,#dcece3);}.ds-button:disabled{opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed;}.ds-button{min-height:42px;font-family:'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#21684b);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button.ds-text{background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: var(--muted,#566e63);}

components.name: 练习输入
components.description: 原生文本输入保留 IME
components.html: <textarea class="ds-input" aria-label="练习输入" placeholder="从第一个字开始…"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-input{display: block; width: 100%; resize: vertical; min-height: 86px; max-height: 180px; padding: 14px 16px; line-height: 1.7; border: 1px solid var(--line,#cbd9d0); background: var(--ground,#edf3f0); color: var(--ink,#203b32); caret-color: var(--accent,#21684b); border-radius: 9px;}.ds-input{min-height: 58px; height: 58px; padding: 10px 14px;}.ds-input::placeholder{color: var(--muted,#566e63);}.ds-input:disabled{opacity: .7;}.ds-input{font-family:'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#21684b);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: 功能导航
components.description: 直角导航按钮以底部下划线标识当前页面
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="主要功能"><button class="ds-button" aria-current="page">自由练习</button><button class="ds-button">个人排行</button><button class="ds-button">练习记录</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 max(24px, calc((100% - 1120px) / 2)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line,#cbd9d0); background: var(--surface,#fcfefd);}.ds-button{cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid var(--line,#cbd9d0); border-radius: 8px; padding: 9px 16px; background: var(--surface,#fcfefd); color: var(--ink,#203b32); transition: background .16s ease-out;}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background: var(--tint,#dcece3);}.ds-button:disabled{opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed;}.ds-button{min-height:42px;font-family:'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16px;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#21684b);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-nav .ds-button{background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: 17px 20px 14px; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--muted,#566e63);}.ds-nav .ds-button[aria-current]{color: var(--accent,#21684b); border-bottom-color: var(--accent,#21684b); font-weight: 650;}

components.name: 按键
components.description: 键帽下缘表现机械键程，按下与对错状态来自真实击键
components.css: .ds-key{display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; height: 34px; background: #254034; border: 1px solid #42604d; border-bottom: 3px solid #0c1c13; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 11px; color: #cfdfd4; transition: background .16s ease-out, transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,1.7,.4,1), box-shadow .22s ease-out;}.ds-key{width:48px;font-family:'Segoe UI','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:11px;}.ds-key.ds-next{border-color: #a6e7ba; color: #b9f4cc;}.ds-key.ds-held{transform: translateY(2px) scale(.97); background: #46634e; border-bottom-width: 1px; transition-duration: .04s;}.ds-key.ds-correct{background: #a6e7ba; border-color: #a6e7ba; color: #142a1c;}.ds-key.ds-error{background: #6c3345; border-color: #ff9cad; color: #ffe8ed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-key{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: 以专注练习为基础，以跟手的键盘反馈为核心。视觉承诺来自用户：键盘反馈是重中之重，速度越快，特效越强。深绿键盘区提供稳定的视觉承载，练习区跟随平台深浅主题。
dos: 保持输入、统计与动画解耦；核心交互必须支持键盘和中文输入法。
任何新增效果都需要在隐藏、暂停、重置、卸载与减少动态效果时正确停止。
donts: 不要为了特效打断输入焦点，不要把本地成绩称为社区排名。
